title: Reference-Free Humanoid Skateboarding via Termination-Shaped Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.26054v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid locomotion research has advanced rapidly on walking and running, but \emph {object-mediated} locomotion, in which a robot must coordinate its body with a passive external object, remains difficult. One challenging task is skateboarding, which requires simultaneous interaction with the ground and a passive but movable platform to achieve forward motion. Current methods for tackling skateboarding with humanoid robots either require human demonstrations or utilise analytic steering models that require system identification. In this paper, we introduce a deep reinforcement learning framework that does not rely on prior data such as demonstrations and enables robots such as the K1 humanoid to learn to skateboard using model-free learning. translated_title: 基于终止塑形强化学习的无参考人形机器人滑板运动
translated_abstract: 人形机器人运动学研究在行走和跑步方面进展迅速，但“物体介导”的运动——即机器人必须与被动外部物体协调配合的运动——仍然十分困难。滑板就是一项具有挑战性的任务，它要求机器人同时与地面和一个被动但可移动的平台交互以实现前进运动。目前人形机器人滑板的方法要么需要人类演示，要么需要使用依赖系统辨识的解析转向模型。本文提出了一种不依赖人类演示等先验数据的深度强化学习框架，使K1等人形机器人能够通过无模型学习学会滑板。该方法将任务奖励与阻断漏洞利用的终止条件相结合，并引入了一系列约束来限制诸如踏板脚脱离滑板、双脚同时站上滑板等不良行为。
tldr: 提出了一种无需人类演示或解析模型的深度强化学习框架，通过任务奖励与终止塑形相结合，使人形机器人（如K1）以无模型方式学会滑板这一物体介导的复杂运动任务。
en_tdlr: A reference-free deep reinforcement learning framework combining task rewards with termination shaping enables humanoid robots like K1 to learn skateboarding without human demonstrations, system identification, or analytic steering models.
